description: Governor's Office - Western Province - Appoint Authorized Officers, under Rent Act, No. 07 of 1972
categorisation: This gazette notification appoints authorized officers (named individuals) for the functions of the Rent Act within the Western Province. The content involves law enforcement and regulatory functions related to rent control, falling under judicial/law enforcement matters rather than core government personnel changes or structural administration. The appointments are made under specific legislative authority (Rent Act) for enforcement purposes.
